name: What are custom floating shelves?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom floating shelves are shelving units installed directly into a wall without visible supports, creating a clean, seamless look. They are designed and built to specific dimensions, materials, and finishes to fit your space and aesthetic preferences. Unlike pre-made shelves, custom options can accommodate unique wall features, precise lengths, or unusual depths, ensuring a perfect fit for your home in areas like Garden City or Meridian.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom floating shelves are shelving units installed into a wall without visible supports, designed to specific dimensions and finishes.
